findings_shown: Employment level in Information & Communications rose by 14.4% between 2020 and 2024.
Employment level in Information & Communications grew at a compound rate of 3.4% a year between 2020 and 2024.
Employment level in Information & Communications fell by 3.1% between 2022 and 2023.
Employment change in Information & Communications totalled +26,800 persons between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4.
Employment change in Information & Communications averaged 2,600 persons less in 2022-Q3 to 2024-Q4 than in 2020-Q1 to 2022-Q2.
Job vacancies in Information & Communications rose by 21.7% between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4.
Job vacancies in IT & Other Information Services rose by 27.5% between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4.

Job vacancies in Information & Communications and employment change in Information & Communications in the same quarter tended to be higher together between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4 (Pearson r 0.47 over 20 quarters; exploratory, not evidence of cause).

valid_summary.sentence: Employment in information and communications grew between 2020 and 2024.
Employment in the sector dipped between 2022 and 2023.
Job vacancies in the sector rose over the period.
Vacancies in IT and other information services rose faster than in the sector as a whole.
Net employment gains were smaller in the later part of the period than in the earlier part.
Quarters with more vacancies tended to see stronger net hiring, an exploratory association rather than evidence of cause.
Both employment and job vacancies in the sector were higher at the end of the period than at the start.
Overall the sector added jobs over the period despite a decline between 2022 and 2023.
The findings do not cover wages or individual occupations.
The evidence covers employment, net employment change and job vacancies in information and communications.
